args.title: Retail Returns & Resale – Combined Summary
args.body:
• Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver in retail logistics.
• Consolidating returns into dedicated handling hubs cut processing costs by about 20%.
• Reselling returned items quickly (within 10 days) preserved most of the product's original margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as a key profitability lever.
